summary.text: Priya Sundareshan was elected to the Arizona Senate in 2023 to represent Legislative District 18, where she is listed as the Democratic Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, she was born and raised in Legislative District 18 and has taught natural resources law at the University of Arizona.

The biography says she previously worked on sustainable resource management with the Environmental Defense Fund and studied engineering at MIT and law and natural resource economics at the University of Arizona.
